fixture: Fair arrival, followed by Thursday day 8 at 10:00. Captures t01–t04 and t15 earn greetings in a clean session. A new fair arrival starts the memory cases. Earlier gameplay methods set up the histories independently; the wallet and trust are staged to the masters for those captures. Rashid's kept-change purchase is staged on the previous day and discovered on Thursday.
method: Native Godot viewport. Real viewport clicks open each talk panel, greet, ask, say goodbye and open What people say. The harness pauses passive clock ticks and stages positions and camera direction at the live locations.
